item.title: The Hidden Ways New Age Ideas Enter the Church
item.description: New Age ideas enter the church disguised as spiritual practices. Doreen Virtue explains why these counterfeits appeal to Christians and why discernment matters.

item.title: Job 18: When Truth Without Love Becomes Cruel
item.description: In Job 18, Bildad speaks again with hardened words and misplaced certainty. Truth misapplied becomes cruelty, but God’s justice is always joined to mercy in Christ.

item.title: Leaning on God’s Strength, Not Our Own
item.description: After leaving the New Age, Doreen Virtue explains why Christians must rely on God’s strength rather than self-effort by abiding in Christ as the true vine (John 15).

item.title: The Core Theological Errors of the New Age Movement
item.description: The New Age movement promotes beliefs that contradict the gospel. Doreen Virtue explains its core theological errors and why biblical discernment matters.

item.title: Job 19: I Know That My Redeemer Lives
item.description: Job 19 reveals Job’s stunning confession of faith in the midst of suffering: “I know that my Redeemer lives.” A Christ-centered daily Bible reading with Dave Jenkins.

item.title: Why Christian Community Matters: Fellowship as a Means of Grace
item.description: Christian community is essential for spiritual growth. Dave Jenkins explains how fellowship, discipleship, and accountability strengthen faith.
